programs.name: Chemours Private Well PFAS Sampling
programs.eligibilitySummary: Free PFAS testing for eligible homes in the lower Cape Fear area. The well must be your home's main source of drinking water.

programs.name: NCDEQ PFAS Treatment System Assistance Program
programs.eligibilitySummary: Partial or full reimbursement for a treatment system when your well is over EPA PFAS standards. The amount depends on the system and your household income, and the well must be your only drinking water source.

programs.name: NCDEQ Bernard Allen Emergency Drinking Water Fund
programs.eligibilitySummary: Can pay for private well testing and a temporary safe drinking water supply for eligible owners whose wells are affected by contamination.
programs.searchQuery: NCDEQ Bernard Allen Emergency Drinking Water Fund

programs.name: Your county health department
programs.eligibilitySummary: Well water testing kits and lab testing for every North Carolina county. Staff can tell you which tests to order and what they cost.

programs.name: NCDHHS Occupational & Environmental Epidemiology Branch
programs.agency: NC Department of Health and Human Services
programs.eligibilitySummary: Free help understanding your well test results and what they mean for your health.

programs.name: Post-flood well disinfection and testing kits
programs.agency: NC DHHS through local health departments
programs.eligibilitySummary: After declared disasters, the state has given out free well disinfection and testing kits through local health departments. Ask yours what is available now.
